title: Security: an external organisation role whose members do not see the member directory and reach data only through explicit grants (portal users on hosted environments)
body:
Ruled: 6355206139 · letter B · 2026-10-23T01:26:35Z

Filing gate ②: from the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/cloud#3149 (batch #386 item 5, 「3149 1 2 5 且第 1 项加 external 角色」, 2026-10-22T13:42Z). Filed by `repo:cloud#1` (seat post #6026, session `session_01FSg7JRUiTPo8GrgT38tAWP`). ⛔ Not a claim. A design card: `domain:spec` + `domain:services`.

**Reader who acts:** the objectstack lane. objectstack-ai/cloud#3149 (the tracker) is `Blocked-by:` this card.

## The gap (cloud#3149 item 1, found while designing objectstack-ai/hotsrm#1)
- On hosted environments the organisation invite is the only way in (objectstack-ai/cloud#3132 ruling), so a supplier's portal users are organisation members.
- The baseline member sets carry the `sys_user_org_members` row scope (`id in current_user.org_user_ids`; `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts:447`, repeated on `viewer_readonly`), and `sys_user` declares the same `defaultRowScope` (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`).
- RLS policies OR-combine, so an app permission set cannot narrow it.
- Result: supplier A's portal users list supplier B's portal accounts, and every supplier sees every employee's name and email.
- ADR-0138 (the v18 guest model) covers the anonymous principal only, not a signed-in external member: this is a new population, not an unused capability.

## The ruling (what binds)
- An organisation invite may carry the role **`external`**, beside owner / admin / member. The better-auth organization plugin's roles are configurable.
- A person holding `external` in the organisation is, in every environment of that organisation, a member whose:
  - **baseline excludes the member directory**: no `sys_user_org_members` row scope, own row only;
  - data comes **only through explicit grants** (positions, permission sets, sharing rules);
  - access is not reached by the `everyone`-anchor default sets.
- The JIT path stamps the population from the role.
- Self-hosted deployments get the same role through the environment's own organisation.
- The record: a dated note on ADR-0135 D2 / D4, mirrored in cloud's ADR-0024. objectstack-ai/cloud#3132 is not reopened; it gains one line.

## Acceptance
- An `external` member of an organisation with two suppliers' portal users reads `sys_user` and `sys_member` and sees its own row only.
- With a permission set granting one object, it reads that object and nothing else.
- An ordinary member is unchanged.
- The cloud's invite flow can issue `external` (cloud follows with its own card when this lands).
